units.source_text: “把这两件事综合起来想想，我那时虽然是个少不更事的青年，也能知道过分轻狂的女子不通道理，不可信赖。

en.t: “Considering these two matters together, even though I was still an inexperienced young man at the time, I could understand that an excessively frivolous woman does not heed reason and cannot be trusted.

units.source_text: 何况今后年事日增，当然更加确信此理了。

en.t: All the more, as I grow older from now on, I will naturally become even more certain of this truth.

units.source_text: 你们诸位都是青春年少，一定恣意任情，

en.t: You gentlemen are all young and in the springtime of life, and surely you let your feelings run as they please,

units.source_text: 贪爱着一碰即落的草上露、一摸即消的竹上霜那样的香艳旖旎、潇洒不拘的风流韵事吧。

en.t: delighting in graceful, alluring, carefree love affairs, like dew on the grass that falls at a touch or frost on bamboo that vanishes when brushed.

units.source_text: 诸君目前虽然如此，但再过七年，定能领会我这道理。

en.t: Though you gentlemen may be like this now, after seven more years you will surely understand this principle of mine.

units.source_text: 务请谅解鄙人这番愚诚的劝谏，小心谨防轻狂浮薄的女子。

en.t: Please accept this foolish but sincere admonition of mine, and be careful to guard yourselves against frivolous and shallow women.

units.source_text: 这种女子会做出丑事，损伤你的芳名！”

en.t: Such women will commit disgraceful acts and damage your good name!”
He warned them in this way.
